Daily Devotional

July 10

38 Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth: 39 But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also. (Matthew 5:38-39 KJV)

Verse 38 above is quoting Old Testament Law from Exodus 21:22-27, Leviticus 24:20 and Deuteronomy 19:21. Notice that it says that you have to respond in kind, otherwise do to them what they do to you. It did not say you could kill someone for stealing from you, but only return the hurt in the same manner they hurt you. That was the Old Testament law.

Jesus teaches us to not respond in kind to those that hurt us, but to give them forgiveness and grace as He gave to us. This doesn’t mean that we can’t resist the devil and evil demons (James 4:7), but we should not respond in kind to individuals that come against us. This can not mean to say we can’t fight our enemies in war, as David, a man after God’s own heart, fought many wars against his enemies. It just means that we should keep the love of God in our hearts and not respond in anger to others (Proverbs 14:29), but give them the same forgiveness that Jesus has given to us. Jesus said that we must forgive others, before the Father in Heaven would forgive us (Matthew 6:14). Thank you Lord for forgiving us sinners.
